Bhaiyābhaṭṭa
or Kṛṣṇabhaṭṭa, son of Bhaṭṭāraka Prabhākara Sūri.
-Dharmaratna or Sujānadharmaratna. written under the patronage of King Sujānasiṃha.
See Kane. HDS. I. ii. 1201a.
See under Dharmaratna.
